entry_proxy: open of the 15:49 start-stamped minute bar
exit_proxy: close of the 15:50 start-stamped minute bar
execution_buffer: one full minute between the final feature bar and the 15:49 entry proxy
primary_definition: keep additions outperforming SPY and deletions underperforming SPY from the 14:48 bar open through the 15:47 bar close
weighting: retain frozen Top-10 weights, then scale the larger surviving leg down so long and short notionals match; never exceed the original 10% name cap; hold residual cash
primary_metric: mean net return per scheduled review at 10 bp
secondary_metrics: mean net return per active review
familywise_control: four-review block sign-flip max-t across all non-baseline fixed rules

walk_forward.objective: highest historical mean net return per scheduled review

retrospective_split.warning: this is a historical split, not a genuine untouched holdout, because the research question was formed after the full sample existed

tight_cutoff_sensitivity: repeat the primary rule through the 15:48 bar close only as a research sensitivity; it is not treated as an executable 15:49-open fill
future_validation: freeze the chosen rule and evaluate the next eight MSCI reviews sequentially without threshold changes
